title: McGregor Loses to Max Holloway at UFC 329
summary: Conor McGregor, a well-known Irish mixed martial artist, suffered an early knee injury in his return fight against Max Holloway at UFC 329. The referee stopped the contest after just 69 seconds due to repeated falls by McGregor. This loss marks a significant setback for McGregor's career, who had been on a five-year layoff. The outcome of this match is a notable event in the world of mixed martial arts.
